# FAK Editor

**Author:** Kibab<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./fak-editor/img/fak-editor.png").default}
  alt={"FAK Editor: screenshot 1"}
/>

FAK Editor is designed for assigning hotkeys on Siemens S75 and SL75.
The program opens the `fak.pd` file, displays key-to-action mappings, and
allows you to add, remove, and modify them.

The list of available actions and keys is stored in Russian and English databases in
editable INI files. If you load `frdb.pd`, the list of actions will include the
MIDlets installed on the phone. Unknown mappings and key modifiers are
preserved unchanged.
